verdict.rationale: Kit's API reference documents core actions like creating/sending broadcasts, subscriber management, bulk processing, and webhooks, and the platform is explicitly positioned as a build-on-top developer platform (kit-docs-1,2,3,18,21,23). However, many major UI-only features advertised on the pricing/marketing pages—landing pages/forms, digital products/subscriptions, surveys, A/B testing, collaborative editing, engagement scoring—have no documented API endpoints, and no OpenAPI spec is publicly discoverable (kit-probe-2), so full UI/API parity isn't evidenced. Missing for 10: API/documentation coverage confirming landing pages, forms, digital product sales, surveys, A/B testing, and collaborative editing are all API-accessible, plus a public machine-readable spec proving completeness.
